subject: Reticle pilot — decision runway & owner alignment
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@reticle.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reticle pilot — decision runway & owner alignment

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed mutual action plan so we have shared expectations going into the pilot. I focused the plan on the three priorities you mentioned: latency-sensitive inference, cost predictability, and audit logging for regulated data.

Key pain points you confirmed:
- Sub-second response requirement for customer-facing inference at 99th percentile (current infra spikes).
- Cost variability month-to-month from bursty batch jobs.
- Need for auditable request/response logs retained for 12 months.

Goals for pilot (success criteria)
- Demonstrate stable 99th percentile latency <= 900 ms across sample traffic.
- Show 30% reduction in per-token cost on production-like workload (compared to current baseline).
- Evidence of end-to-end logging and a short sample audit report.

Proposed mutual action plan (milestones & owners):
1) Pilot kickoff & scope confirmation — target: 2028-07-09 — Owner: Jordan (Reticle) + Kimberly (Redwood) — deliverable: signed scope doc.
2) Access & environment setup (VPC peering, credentials, test dataset) — target: 2028-07-16 — Owner: Priya (Procurement)/Reticle IT + Marissa (Redwood SRE) — deliverable: connectivity test results.
3) Performance baseline & tuning (initial runs, batching/quant settings) — target: 2028-07-23 — Owner: Ben (Redwood AE) + Reticle infra lead — deliverable: baseline report.
4) Validation & audit sample (trace + logs retained) — target: 2028-07-30 — Owner: Reticle compliance + Kimberly — deliverable: short audit report.
5) Decision checkpoint (go/no-go for production) — target: 2028-08-06 — Owner: Jordan + Reticle exec sponsor — deliverable: written decision and next steps.

Attachments: I attached an editable MPA workbook (reticle-mpa-draft.xlsx) with milestones and a preliminary pricing quote (redwood-pricing-quote.pdf). Please review and tell me what to change.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Jordan: confirm procurement owners and any calendar conflicts for the kickoff week by EOD Tue (2028-07-03).
- Priya (if on this thread): confirm the procurement checklist items (PO, contract SLA questions).
- Kimberly/Ben/Marissa: we will prepare a concise kickoff slide (1 page) and updated MPA after your notes.

If the dates look tight, flag any constraints and we can slide the runway accordingly. Appreciate the clear priorities — I think this is a good short runway to a decision.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clean recap and the MPA. This aligns with what I heard on our side. A couple of notes:
- Procurement / legal will need the pricing sheet to include data residency and a short SLA paragraph — Priya, looping you in.
- Our infra lead (cc: infra@reticle.io) is out next week; can the environment setup window be shifted by one week if needed?

Owners: I confirm I will be the executive sponsor and Priya will own procurement. Can you add our infra lead (Asha Rao, asha.rao@reticle.io) to the kickoff invite?

Dates: the proposed runway looks reasonable, but we may need to push the environment setup target to 2028-07-23 if our infra lead's availability is constrained.

Next step for me: I will confirm the procurement checklist and any PO timing by EOD Wed (2028-07-04).

Jordan Miles
Director of Product — Reticle Inc
jordan.miles@reticle.io

Subject: Re: Reticle pilot — decision runway & owner alignment

Jordan / Asha / Priya —

Appreciate the quick response and for confirming sponsors/owners. I updated the MPA to slide the environment setup to 2028-07-23 and added Asha as the infra contact. Ben and Marissa will lead the tuning and environment validation.

Action items from Redwood: 
- Ben: prepare baseline runbook and a short how-to for the VPC peering test by 2028-07-10.
- Marissa: schedule a 30-minute walkthrough on the audit/logging retention options with Reticle compliance — propose 2028-07-18 or 2028-07-19.
- Kimberly: will send the kickoff invite for week of 2028-07-09 with updated attendee list (pending Asha availability).

I attached an updated MPA workbook (same filename) with the changed dates. If Priya/legal need explicit SLA language in the quote PDF, Ben — can you add a short paragraph about the 99th percentile latency and an outline of our standard uptime SLA? I can draft a suggested clause if helpful.

Thanks all — small tweak to the runway but still on target for a decision in early August.

Best,

Kimberly
